definitions.pick: Verified physical lift, hand contact and table unloading
definitions.place: Measured shelf support before the supported slide
definitions.final_position: Back-contact/upright dwell, then unloaded release satisfying unchanged task geometry/velocity/support conditions
definitions.retreat: Release and clear completed; current and previously placed cartons stable for task dwell, no product tipped/dropped during retreat
definitions.clean_success: Process exited normally, complete task, all four stages, no product tipped >45 degrees or dropped below 0.25m at any monitored physics step
definitions.unreached: Counted as zero in the scheduled-object denominator; not silently omitted
